description: This Java class defines a helper class 'PreSharedKeyDeviceIdentity' that implements the 'DeviceCredentials' interface. It encapsulates device identity information based on pre-shared keys, including tenant ID and auth ID, and provides methods for creating instances from a string identity, equality checks, and retrieving credentials information.

classes.name: PreSharedKeyDeviceIdentity
classes.description: Represents a device identity based on a pre-shared key, with tenant ID and auth ID, supporting equality and hash operations.

methods.name: PreSharedKeyDeviceIdentity
methods.description: Constructor that initializes tenantId, authId, and precomputes the hash code.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from an identity string, optionally parsing tenant and auth IDs.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Returns the authentication ID that the device wants to authenticate as.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID the device claims to belong to.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the object, based on tenantId and authId.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on tenantId and authId.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the credentials type constant for pre-shared key.
